label: Active power and energy
definition: Real power, measured in MW, and the energy it delivers over time, measured in MWh. Covers both energy trades and MW of active-power availability or response.

label: Reactive power
definition: The part of AC power set by the phase difference between voltage and current, measured in MVAr. It is absorbed or injected to control voltage.

label: Stability (inertia and short-circuit level)
definition: Contributions to system inertia and short-circuit level that help the system withstand disturbances.

label: Firm capacity
definition: A commitment to have reliable capacity (MW) available at times of system stress, paid for separately from any energy sold.
